what: The moment a work card reaches its spot (60% of the screen for a horizontal strip, 75% for vertical), a white flash switches on in the photo cell for .04s and turns off at .7s, and the board pops to 1.035x · ±1.8° (alternating by card) then settles with a .9s elastic.out(1.1, .3) shake. At .12s a ”Done” stamp wipes in from the left over .32s, at .45s a shadow appears under the photo, and from .55s the text lines rise from 18px below over .6s expo.out at .08 intervals. Once only

options.axis: x (cards in a horizontal strip) or y (default) — what reaches the position
options.at: Landing spot (screen ratio), default x .6 · y .75
options.tilt: Tilt angle (deg) when bouncing, default 1.8 — alternates in the opposite direction per card
options.[data-fx-part=box · media · flash · stam: Board to bounce (the element if none) · photo cell to cover the flash · flash (the part makes one if none) · stamp · shade · text lines to rise later

note: Position detection uses scroll and the GSAP ticker, so it still catches horizontal movement inside a pinned band. With reduced motion, everything is visible from the start.
